original_rows.source: {Give 50 Rations.} I wish to give an offering to Heimdallr that he may grant me vigilance.
original_rows.translation: {Give 50 Rations.} 我想向海姆达尔献上祭品，愿他赐予我警觉。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"保护标记{Give 50 Rations.}为程序/格式内容，按规则原样保留不译，故未套用“口粮”译名。","source":"Rations"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {献上50份口粮。} 我想向海姆达尔献上祭品，愿他赐予我警觉。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Valuables 处于花括号游戏变量标记内，必须原样保留，不能译为“贵重物品”。","source":"Valuables"}]

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} I sentence you to death.
{Attack.} Sorry Dubglas, we're saving your cousin.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 抱歉，杜布格拉斯，我们得去救你表亲。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 抱歉，杜布格拉斯，我们得去救你表亲。

original_rows.source: {Show Sefa's necklace.} I have a question first. Have you ever seen a necklace like this?
original_rows.translation: {Show Sefa's necklace.} 我先问个问题。你见过这样的项链吗？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"该短语位于花括号游戏标记内，保护标记要求原样保留，不能译为“塞法的项链”。","source":"Sefa's necklace"},{"reason":"{Show Sefa's necklace.} 为游戏标记，按保护要求原样保留，不拆分翻译。","source":"{Show Sefa's necklace.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {出示塞法的项链。} 我先问个问题。你见过这样的项链吗？

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} How about I just take everything!
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 不如我把东西全拿走！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 不如我把东西全拿走！

original_rows.source: [i]Sancta Maria Mater Dei ora pro nobis peccatoribus nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.[/i]
original_rows.translation: [i]Sancta Maria Mater Dei ora pro nobis peccatoribus nunc et in hora mortis nostrae.[/i]
original_rows.proposed_translation: [i]圣母玛利亚，天主之母，求你现在和我们临终时，为我们罪人祈求天主。[/i]

original_rows.source: {Attack.} Caustantin mac Fergusa sends his regards!
original_rows.translation: {Attack.}考斯坦丁·马克·费尔古萨向你问好！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。}考斯坦丁·马克·费尔古萨向你问好！

original_rows.source: {Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} Osred sent me to get a report from you.
original_rows.translation: {Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} 奥斯雷德派我来听你汇报。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Willibrord 位于保护标记 {Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} 内，该标记须原样保留，不得翻译或替换。","source":"Willibrord"},{"reason":"{Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} 是保护标记文本，本句已原样保留，未作翻译。","source":"{Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {向他展示威利布罗德给的缎带。} 奥斯雷德派我来听你汇报。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} You're right. I'll grant you a swift death.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.}你说得对。我会赐你一个迅捷的死亡。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。}你说得对。我会赐你一个迅捷的死亡。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} I'm not falling for this! To arms!
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我才不会上这个当！拿起武器！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 我才不会上这个当！拿起武器！

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} Where is your god now, old man?
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 老家伙，你的上帝现在在哪儿？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处 man 是“old man”中的普通称呼“老家伙”，并非“男子”这一性别称谓；口语对白中此处这样译更自然。","source":"man"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 老家伙，你的上帝现在在哪儿？

original_rows.source: {Spare him.} I'm sorry it had to be this way.
original_rows.translation: {Spare him.}很抱歉，事情走到了这一步。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {饶他一命。}很抱歉，事情走到了这一步。

original_rows.source: {Spare him.} Accept your defeat with dignity.
original_rows.translation: {Spare him.} 体面地接受你的失败吧。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {饶他一命。} 体面地接受你的失败吧。

original_rows.source: {Stab him.} It's time you meet your "saint" in person.
original_rows.translation: {Stab him.} 是时候让你亲眼见见你的“圣”了。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"{Stab him.} 为受保护标记，必须原样保留，不翻译；现译正确。","source":"{Stab him.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {捅死他。} 是时候让你亲眼见见你的“圣”了。

original_rows.source: {Nod politely and leave the way you came.}
original_rows.translation: {Nod politely and leave the way you came.}
original_rows.proposed_translation: {礼貌地点头致意，然后顺着来路退出去。}

original_rows.source: {Kiss him.} Sounds like a win-win situation to me.
original_rows.translation: {Kiss him.} 在我看来，这听起来是个双赢的局面。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {吻他。} 在我看来，这听起来是个双赢的局面。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} My father always said the best defence is an unexpected attack.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我父亲总说，最好的防御就是出人意料的进攻。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处 my father 是“我父亲”，亲属称谓，不是神父；现译正确。","source":"father"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {进攻。} 我父亲总说，最好的防御就是出人意料的进攻。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} I see where this is going.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我明白这是要往哪去了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 我明白这是要往哪去了。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} Remember how I said I'd kill you last? [i]I lied![/i]
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.}还记得我说过要把你留到最后杀吗？[i]我骗你的！[/i]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。}还记得我说过要把你留到最后杀吗？[i]我骗你的！[/i]

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"该文本整体由花括号标记保护，属于锁定不译的占位/标记内容，指令要求原样保留保护标记与锁定译文，故保留原文 Asleifr 不改。","source":"Asleifr"}]

original_rows.source: {Offer 10 Valuables.} We'll give a silver piece.
original_rows.translation: {Offer 10 Valuables.} 我们会出一枚银币。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"“Valuables”位于受保护的花括号指令标记内，必须原样保留标记文本，故不译作“贵重物品”。","source":"Valuables"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {奉上10份贵重物品。} 我们会出一枚银币。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} I've got some bad news for you...
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我有个坏消息要告诉你……
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 我有个坏消息要告诉你……

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} Thank you, I'll grant you a swift death.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 谢谢，我会让你死个痛快。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处swift death是“迅速的死”，原译“死个痛快”自然贴切，并非技能名“迅捷”，不宜套用术语译名。","source":"swift"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 谢谢，我会让你死个痛快。

original_rows.source: {Spare him.} You're done Æthelred. Be a man about it.
original_rows.translation: {Spare him.} 你完了，埃塞尔雷德。拿出点男子汉的样子来。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {饶了他。} 你完了，埃塞尔雷德。拿出点男子汉的样子来。

original_rows.source: {Leave.} I bid you far vel for now.
original_rows.proposed_translation: {离开。} 暂且与你道声再见。

original_rows.source: {Abandon quest.} I will tell Caustantin his druid is dead.
original_rows.translation: {Abandon quest.}我会去告诉考斯坦丁，他的德鲁伊死了。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"quest 出现在保护标记 {Abandon quest.} 内，属须原样保留的游戏标记，不能译为“任务”；标记外正文不含该词。","source":"quest"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {放弃任务。}我会去告诉考斯坦丁，他的德鲁伊死了。

original_rows.source: {Attack them.} It doesn't matter. You'll be joining him momentarily.
original_rows.translation: {Attack them.} 无所谓。你很快就会去陪他。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击他们。} 无所谓。你很快就会去陪他。

original_rows.source: {Try to sneak up on them and kill them silently.}
original_rows.translation: {Try to sneak up on them and kill them silently.}
original_rows.proposed_translation: {试图悄悄摸近，无声无息地杀死他们。}

original_rows.source: {Abandon quest.} You kids have fun with your little party. When you finally slink back to Cater, tell him I tried.
original_rows.translation: {Abandon quest.} 你们这些小鬼尽管去开你们的派对开心吧。等你们最后灰溜溜地溜回凯特尔那儿，告诉他我尽力了。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"“{Abandon quest.}”是受保护的游戏标记，须原样保留，不能翻译其中的 quest；正文已无普通词义 quest 可套用“任务”。","source":"quest"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {放弃任务。} 你们这些小鬼尽管去开你们的派对开心吧。等你们最后灰溜溜地溜回凯特尔那儿，告诉他我尽力了。

original_rows.source: {Grab him and throw him to the ground.}
original_rows.translation: {Grab him and throw him to the ground.}

original_rows.source: {Give 4 Rations.} Your road is a tough one. Take this - it will help.
original_rows.translation: {Give 4 Rations.} 你这条路不好走。拿着吧——会有用的。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"“{Give 4 Rations.}”是受保护游戏标记，须原样保留，不能翻译其中的 Rations；正文无普通词义可套用“口粮”。","source":"Rations"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {给4份口粮。} 你这条路不好走。拿着吧——会有用的。

original_rows.source: {Spare him.} I hope you enjoyed your brief time on the throne. It's mine now.
original_rows.translation: {Spare him.} 但愿你在王位上这段时间过得还算满意。现在这王位归我了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {饶他一命。} 但愿你在王位上这段时间过得还算满意。现在这王位归我了。

original_rows.source: {Show Sefa's necklace.} Have you ever seen a necklace like this?
original_rows.translation: {Show Sefa's necklace.} 你见过这样的项链吗？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"原句用“a necklace like this”指项链这种物品并作比较，并非专名指称；“这样的项链”符合语境，强行套用“塞法的项链”会改变句意。","source":"Sefa's necklace"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {展示塞法的项链。} 你见过这样的项链吗？

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"花括号内的 {Give 500 Valuables.} 是游戏标记/变量文本，按规则原样保留不译；玩家可见部分“把钱拿去就是了”已表达语义。","source":"Valuables"},{"reason":"} 属于保护标记的一部分，原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {交出500财宝。} 把钱拿去就是了。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"花括号内 {Give 2000 Valuables.} 为游戏标记/变量文本，原样保留；玩家可见文本已译出语义。","source":"Valuables"},{"reason":"} 属于保护标记的一部分，原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {交出2000财宝。} 我接受你的条件。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} How about we end that stalemate right now?
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 不如我们现在就了结这个僵局吧？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"本句 end that stalemate 中 end 为动词“了结”，并非名词“体魄”，现译正确。","source":"end"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 不如我们现在就了结这个僵局吧？

original_rows.source: {Abandon goal.} He didn't tell me. You'll have to ask him yourselves. Fare well.
original_rows.translation: {Abandon goal.} 他没告诉我。你们自己去问他吧。保重。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"本句 goal 位于受保护标记 {Abandon goal.} 内，按规则须保留原文，不能译为“目标”。","source":"goal"},{"reason":"源文中的花括号“}”为标记组成部分，保护标记要求原样保留。","source":"}"},{"reason":"完整标记 {Abandon goal.} 须原样保留，不翻译其内部文字。","source":"{Abandon goal.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {放弃目标。} 他没告诉我。你们自己去问他吧。保重。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"源文花括号内 {Kill Gunnarr.} 为占位/标记内容，保护标记要求原样保留，故未译其中 Gunnarr；花括号外译文正确。","source":"Gunnarr"},{"reason":"源文中的花括号“}”为保护标记组成部分，须原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀死贡纳尔。} 这我不能接受。

original_rows.source: {Give 200 Valuables.} You've got yourself a deal.
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"原句“{Give 200 Valuables.}”是游戏标记内的资源名，需与游戏内资源条目一致；术语表“贵重物品”为通用译名，但该标记属保护内容，按规则不译内部文本，保留原文正确。","source":"Valuables"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {交付200财物。} 这买卖成交了。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} This is going to be fun.
{Accept it, wrapping your hands around hers as you do so.} Thank you. I promise I'll use it well.
original_rows.translation: {Accept it, wrapping your hands around hers as you do so.} 谢谢你。我保证会好好用它。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {接过它，用你的双手包住她的手。} 谢谢你。我保证会好好用它。

original_rows.source: {Kill them.} Nothing's more dangerous than a courageous thrall. We'd better kill them.
original_rows.translation: {Kill them.} 没什么比一个胆大的奴隶更危险的了。我们最好杀了他们。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他们。} 没什么比一个胆大的奴隶更危险的了。我们最好杀了他们。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} I just wanted you to admit that so I can justify [i]this[/i].
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我只是想让你承认这一点，这样我才能为[i]这[/i]找个正当理由。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 我只是想让你承认这一点，这样我才能为[i]这[/i]找个正当理由。

original_rows.source: {Jokingly.} Took you long enough to get here.
{Give her the flowers from the animal pen.} Are these the flowers you said grow near animals?
original_rows.translation: {Give her the flowers from the animal pen.}这些就是你说长在牲口附近的花？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Are是句首疑问助动词，与these构成疑问句，并非地名阿雷，故保留。","source":"Are"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {把从牲口棚附近采来的花递给她。}这些就是你说长在牲口附近的花？

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} I'm sorry it had to be this way.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.}很抱歉，事情非得走到这一步。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {结果他的性命。}很抱歉，事情非得走到这一步。

original_rows.source: {Let her join.} Point well made. All right, you can come.
original_rows.translation: {Let her join.}说得好。行吧，你可以一起来。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {让她加入。}说得好。行吧，你可以一起来。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"保护标记 {Kill Gunnarr.} 内 Gunnarr 属不可改动脚本内容，须原样保留；正文未出现该人名，故不替换为“贡纳尔”。","source":"Gunnarr"}]

original_rows.proposed_translation: {撒谎。} 我们什么都没找到……

original_rows.source: {Attack.} Quite on the contrary in fact.
{Pay him.} Here you go. Don't show your father.
original_rows.translation: {Pay him.} 拿去吧。别让你父亲看见。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处father指听话人的生父，是亲属称谓，而非神父；原句为私密叮嘱，译作“父亲”符合语境。","source":"father"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {付钱给他。} 拿去吧。别让你父亲看见。

original_rows.source: {Show Sefa's necklace.} Have you ever seen a necklace like this?
original_rows.translation: {Show Sefa's necklace.} 你见过这样的项链吗？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Sefa's necklace 位于受保护游戏标记内，按保护规则原样保留，其后译文“这样的项链”在语境中指向同一物。","source":"Sefa's necklace"},{"reason":"整个 {Show Sefa's necklace.} 为游戏标记，必须原样保留，现译文完全保留。","source":"{Show Sefa's necklace.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {亮出塞法的项链。} 你见过这样的项链吗？

original_rows.source: {Kill the girl.} Release him, but let this be a lesson to you, thrall, to not run off again.
original_rows.translation: {Kill the girl.}放了他，但记住这个教训，奴隶，别再跑了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了这丫头。}放了他，但记住这个教训，奴隶，别再跑了。

original_rows.source: {Ally with Pictavia.} Magnus - Dun Phris belongs to Pictavia.
original_rows.translation: {Ally with Pictavia.}马格努斯——邓弗里斯属于皮克特维亚。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {与皮克塔维亚结盟。}马格努斯——邓弗里斯属于皮克特维亚。

original_rows.source: Stuck up. Self-righteous. Over-confident, over-eager. {She shrugs.} He's all right.
original_rows.translation: 傲慢。自以为是。过度自信，急于求成。{She shrugs.} 他还行。
original_rows.proposed_translation: 傲慢。自以为是。过度自信，急于求成。{她耸耸肩。} 他还行。
{把你的指关节按得咔咔作响。}

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"原文 Pull 只位于必须逐字保留的 {Pull free.} 保护标记内；译文完整保留该标记，不能另把内部 Pull 译作“钩拽”。","source":"Pull"}]

original_rows.source: {Offer 2 Rations.} A cup of mead to gain Thorr's favour.
original_rows.translation: {Offer 2 Rations.}敬一杯蜂蜜酒，以求托尔眷顾。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"{Offer 2 Rations.} 为游戏标记或占位文本，保持原样，未译出“口粮”，符合保留标记要求。","source":"Rations"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {献上2份口粮。}敬一杯蜂蜜酒，以求托尔眷顾。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} We kill the guards now, deal with the consequences later.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我们现在就杀了守卫，后果以后再说。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {动手。} 我们现在就杀了守卫，后果以后再说。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} You've all brought this on yourselves.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 这一切都是你们自找的。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 这一切都是你们自找的。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Raid 位于保护标记 {Raid the garden.} 内，须原样保留，不套用术语译名。","source":"Raid"}]

original_rows.source: {Attack.} They look disorganised, this shouldn't be too difficult. Let's just get it over with.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 他们看起来乱糟糟的，应该不会太难。赶紧了结吧。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 他们看起来乱糟糟的，应该不会太难。赶紧了结吧。

original_rows.source: {Give her the Eagle Standard.} It's yours.
original_rows.translation: {Give her the Eagle Standard.} 它是你的了。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"“Eagle Standard”位于花括号保护标记内，属于必须原样保留的游戏标记，翻译会破坏标记结构，故保留原文。","source":"Eagle Standard"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {把鹰旗交给她。} 它是你的了。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"“cargo”位于花括号保护标记内，属于必须原样保留的游戏标记，翻译会破坏标记结构，故保留原文。","source":"cargo"}]

original_rows.source: {Draw your weapon.} Have it your way.
original_rows.proposed_translation: {拔出你的武器。} 随你便吧。

original_rows.source: {Kill the young woman.} Have it your way.
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了那年轻女人。} 随你便。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"{Give 500 Valuables.} 是游戏内嵌的指令/脚本标记，须保留原文不译，故不套用“贵重物品”。","source":"Valuables"}]

original_rows.source: {Lie.} Your horn was almost empty - I was going to refill it for you.
original_rows.translation: {Lie.} 你的号角都快空了——我正打算替你满上。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {撒谎。} 你的号角都快空了——我正打算替你满上。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} Let's put that good fortune to the test.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 那就来试试这份好运吧。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 那就来试试这份好运吧。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} If that's the way you want to play this, fine!
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 你要是想这么玩，那就来吧！
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处 fine 是口语感叹，意为“好吧/那就这样吧”，并非人名“芬妮”；套用术语会误译。","source":"fine"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 你要是想这么玩，那就来吧！

original_rows.source: {Spare him.} You fought well. I will spare you, if you and your family leave and never return.
original_rows.translation: {Spare him.}你打得很好。如果你和你的家人离开、永不回来，我就饶你一命。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {饶他一命。}你打得很好。如果你和你的家人离开、永不回来，我就饶你一命。

original_rows.source: {Kill them.} Well we're here to get rid of you!
original_rows.translation: {Kill them.} 我们就是来收拾你的！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {灭了他们。} 我们就是来收拾你的！

original_rows.source: {Show sword.} I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I found a sword engraved with his name next to some remains not too far from here.
original_rows.translation: {Show sword.} 我不想带来坏消息，但我在这儿不远处的一些遗骸旁，发现了刻着他名字的剑。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {展示长剑。} 我不想带来坏消息，但我在这儿不远处的一些遗骸旁，发现了刻着他名字的剑。

original_rows.source: {Reject deal.} Perhaps we could work out something else.
original_rows.translation: {Reject deal.} 也许我们可以另谈个办法。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {拒绝交易。} 也许我们可以另谈个办法。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} You've given me everything I need. Time to die.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 你已经给了我需要的一切。该死了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 你已经给了我需要的一切。该死了。
{刺死他。} 没什么好说的了。

original_rows.source: {Recruit her.} Skjern could use a good merchant.
original_rows.translation: {Recruit her.} 斯凯恩正缺一个好商人。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {招募她。} 斯凯恩正缺一个好商人。

original_rows.source: {Offer 5000 Valuables.} If you stand aside, not only will I restore the kingdoms of Pictavia to their natural sovereignty, I will reward you richly.
original_rows.translation: {Offer 5000 Valuables.} 你若让开，我不仅会让皮克特维亚的诸王国恢复应有的主权，还会重重赏你。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"源文“{Offer 5000 Valuables.}”是游戏占位/指令标记，须原样保留，Valuables不能替换为“贵重物品”。","source":"Valuables"},{"reason":"右花括号“}”是保护标记组成部分，译文原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {献上 5000 财宝。} 你若让开，我不仅会让皮克特维亚的诸王国恢复应有的主权，还会重重赏你。

original_rows.source: {Pay 500 Valuables, get 200 wood.} I'll pay you 50 ørtug of silver for the job.
original_rows.translation: {Pay 500 Valuables, get 200 wood.} 这活儿我付你五十厄尔图格银币。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"保护标记内的游戏指令原文须原样保留，Valuables 不替换。","source":"Valuables"},{"reason":"保护标记内的 wood 属指令文本，原样保留。","source":"wood"},{"reason":"“}”为保护标记组成部分，原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {支付 500 财宝，获得 200 木材。} 这活儿我付你五十厄尔图格银币。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"保护标记内的 Poison 属游戏指令，须原样保留。","source":"Poison"},{"reason":"整体占位指令 {Give 5 Poison.} 按保护要求原样保留。","source":"{Give 5 Poison.}"},{"reason":"“}”为保护标记组成部分，原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {给予 5 份毒药。} 给——小心点。

original_rows.source: {You get 100 wood.} You keep half the wood, ship the rest up to Skjern.
original_rows.translation: {You get 100 wood.}你留下半数木材，其余的运往斯凯恩。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处 rest 是“其余、剩下的部分”（half the wood, ship the rest），不是“休息”之意，译作“其余的”正确，不套用术语译名“休息”。","source":"rest"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {你获得了100木材。}你留下半数木材，其余的运往斯凯恩。

original_rows.source: {Give 10000 Valuables.} I have the silver you asked for. Consider it a deal!
original_rows.translation: {Give 10000 Valuables.} 你要的银子我带来了。就当成交吧！
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"原文花括号内为游戏指令标记 {Give 10000 Valuables.}，需原样保留不译；术语 Valuables 在此为指令参数，玩家可见译文对应后文 silver“银子”。","source":"Valuables"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {献上10000财物。} 你要的银子我带来了。就当成交吧！

original_rows.translation: {Drink.} 干杯，你……你这娘们！再来一杯！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {喝。} 干杯，你……你这娘们！再来一杯！

original_rows.source: {Attack} I'm afraid your journey will be much shorter than you anticipated.
original_rows.translation: {Attack} 恐怕你的旅程会比你预想的短得多。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击} 恐怕你的旅程会比你预想的短得多。

original_rows.source: {Give 50 Rations.} I wish to give an offering to Thorr that I may be granted some of his strength.
original_rows.translation: {Give 50 Rations.} 我想向托尔献上祭品，好从他那里求得一些力量。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Rations 位于花括号内的游戏指令标记 {Give 50 Rations.} 中，属于需保留的 UI 指令原文，不应译为“口粮”；译文保留指令原文，符合保护标记要求。","source":"Rations"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {给予50份口粮。} 我想向托尔献上祭品，好从他那里求得一些力量。

original_rows.source: {Buy spear for 150 Valuables.} I'll take the spear for 15 ørtug of silver.
original_rows.translation: {Buy spear for 150 Valuables.} 我用15厄尔图格银买这柄矛。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"本句 Valuables 仅出现在保护标记 {Buy spear for 150 Valuables.} 内，该标记须整体原样保留，故不译为“贵重物品”；后半句台词中没有该词。","source":"Valuables"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {花费150财宝购买矛。} 我用15厄尔图格银买这柄矛。

original_rows.source: Tho glad to thee you again, my highly honourable thegn! Are you looking to peruthe our fine thelection of metalth and hideth?
original_rows.translation: Tho glad to thee you again, my highly honourable thegn! Are you looking to peruthe our fine thelection of metalth and hideth?
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"整句为刻意错拼的戏谑台词，honourable 不按“重荣誉”套用，保留原文以维持口音笑点。","source":"honourable"},{"reason":"整句保留原文，thegn 不按“领主”替换，避免破坏刻意错拼台词。","source":"thegn"},{"reason":"Are 在此为助动词，且整句保留原文，不套用专名“阿雷”。","source":"Are"},{"reason":"fine 在此为普通形容词“上好的”，且整句保留原文，不套用“芬妮”。","source":"fine"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: 再次见到您真是太好啦，我最最尊贵的领主！您是来瞧我们精选的上好金属和皮革吗？

original_rows.source: {Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} Osred sent me to get a report from you.
original_rows.translation: {Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.} 奥斯雷德派我来向你要一份报告。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Willibrord 位于花括号保护标记内，须原样保留，不译“威利布罗德”。","source":"Willibrord"},{"reason":"该花括号整句为程序标记内容，按保护标记规则原样保留。","source":"{Show him the ribbon from Willibrord.}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {给他看威利布罗德给的绶带。} 奥斯雷德派我来向你要一份报告。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} I'm sorry. No one is to be spared.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 对不起。谁也不能幸免。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 对不起。谁也不能幸免。

original_rows.source: {Show Sefa's necklace.} Have you ever seen a necklace like this?
original_rows.translation: {Show Sefa's necklace.} 你见过这样的项链吗？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"花括号内 {Show Sefa's necklace.} 是须原样保留的游戏标记，不能翻译；花括号外的项链指代已由该标记表达，故正文无需套用“塞法的项链”。","source":"Sefa's necklace"},{"reason":"{Show Sefa's necklace.} 为保护标记，须原样保留，不套用术语译文。","source":"{Show Sefa's necklace.}"},{"reason":"} 为保护标记原字符，须原样保留。","source":"}"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {展示塞法的项链。} 你见过这样的项链吗？

original_rows.source: {Show Sefa's necklace.} Have you ever seen a necklace like this?
original_rows.translation: {Show Sefa's necklace.}你见过这样的项链吗？
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Sefa's necklace 在此为程序指令内容且按保护标记原样保留；后句“这样的项链”已准确指代，无需在可见文本中另套译名。","source":"Sefa's necklace"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {亮出塞法的项链。}你见过这样的项链吗？

original_rows.source: {Go back to your own tent to sleep.}
original_rows.translation: {Go back to your own tent to sleep.}

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Valuables 位于程序指令 {Bribe with 200 Valuables.} 内，属保护标记，按规则原样保留，不译作“贵重物品”。","source":"Valuables"},{"reason":"此句 Fine 是口语应答“好吧”，并非人名芬妮，现译准确自然。","source":"Fine"}]

original_rows.source: I can barely breathe {COUGH! COUGH!} the smoke...
original_rows.translation: 我几乎喘不上气{COUGH! COUGH!}这烟……
original_rows.proposed_translation: 我几乎喘不上气{咳！咳！}这烟……

original_rows.source: {Stab him.} Your followers will be gone soon, but you will not be coming with them.
original_rows.translation: {Stab him.}你的随从很快就要走了，但你不会跟他们一起走。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {刺死他。}你的随从很快就要走了，但你不会跟他们一起走。

original_rows.source: {Ignore the firefly.} Sounds like you need to get out of here. You'd be safer in Perth if you come with us.
original_rows.translation: {Ignore the firefly.} 听起来你得离开这儿。要是跟我们走，你在珀斯会更安全。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {懒得理那只萤火虫。} 听起来你得离开这儿。要是跟我们走，你在珀斯会更安全。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} You won't be here much longer...
original_rows.proposed_translation: {动手。} 你在这儿待不久了……

original_rows.source: {Attack.} If a fight is unavoidable today, the village is the weaker foe. You won't need to translate [i]this[/i], Morcant.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 如果今天这一战避不开，村里的人更好对付。你不用翻译[i]这个[/i]，莫坎特。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {动手。} 如果今天这一战避不开，村里的人更好对付。你不用翻译[i]这个[/i]，莫坎特。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} I struck a deal. Your life for the boy's.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.} 我做了笔交易。用你的命换那孩子的命。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。} 我做了笔交易。用你的命换那孩子的命。

original_rows.source: {Attack.} You dare ask me for alms?! You'll pay for this insolence!
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 你竟敢向我讨施舍？！你会为这无礼付出代价！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。} 你竟敢向我讨施舍？！你会为这无礼付出代价！

original_rows.source: {Attack.} It would be a tremendous help to me [i]if you'd die![/i]
original_rows.translation: {Attack.}你要是死了，[i]对我可是天大的帮助！[/i]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {攻击。}你要是死了，[i]对我可是天大的帮助！[/i]

original_rows.source: {Face Asleifr in the ring.} No, I'm looking forward to teaching Asleifr a lesson.
original_rows.translation: {Face Asleifr in the ring.}不，我可盼着好好教训阿斯莱夫一顿。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {在角斗场中面对阿斯莱芙尔。}不，我可盼着好好教训阿斯莱夫一顿。

original_rows.source: {Leave.} Do what you want with the kid. It's out of my hands.
original_rows.translation: {Leave.} 那孩子你想怎么处置就怎么处置。这事我管不着了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {离开。} 那孩子你想怎么处置就怎么处置。这事我管不着了。

original_rows.source: {Leave.} This is a waste of my time.
original_rows.translation: {Leave.} 这纯粹是浪费我的时间。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {走吧。} 这纯粹是浪费我的时间。

original_rows.source: {Kill him.} I'll end the curse with your death.
original_rows.translation: {Kill him.}我会用你的死来终结这诅咒。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处 end 为动词“终结”，宾语为 the curse，并非术语“体魄”。","source":"end"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了他。}我会用你的死来终结这诅咒。

original_rows.source: {Grab the survivor.} Who sent you? Speak!
original_rows.proposed_translation: {抓住幸存者。}是谁派你来的？说！

original_rows.source: {Lie.} I already have, Hlafdia. The poet is dead.
original_rows.translation: {Lie.} 我已经办妥了，女领主。诗人死了。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {撒谎。} 我已经办妥了，女领主。诗人死了。
{好好估量一下你周围的环境。}

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"原文整句处于花括号游戏标记内，属保护标记文本，未翻译，术语疑问不适用。","source":"Ready"},{"reason":"原文整句处于花括号游戏标记内，属保护标记文本，未翻译，术语疑问不适用。","source":"weapons"}]

original_rows.source: {Let the girl go.} We must be more vigilant in the future.
original_rows.translation: {Let the girl go.}今后我们必须更加警觉。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {放了那女孩。}今后我们必须更加警觉。

original_rows.source: Use the Elm. {High Cargo / Low Intimidation / Low Speed}
original_rows.translation: 使用榆树号。{High Cargo / Low Intimidation / Low Speed}
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"Cargo 位于 t19 要求保留原文的整个花括号占位串内，属需原样保留的变量内容，不单独改为“载货”。","source":"Cargo"},{"reason":"Low Intimidation 位于 t19 要求保留原文的花括号占位串内，须原样保留，不套用“低威吓”。","source":"Low Intimidation"},{"reason":"Speed 位于 t19 要求保留原文的花括号占位串内，须原样保留，不套用“速度”。","source":"Speed"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: 使用榆树号。{载货量大 / 威慑低 / 航速慢}

original_rows.source: {Attack.} I've decided to accept a better offer.
original_rows.translation: {Attack.} 我已决定接受一个更好的提议。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {动手。} 我已决定接受一个更好的提议。

original_rows.source: {Show sword.} I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but I found a sword engraved with his name next to some remains not too far from here.
original_rows.translation: {Show sword.} 我也不想带来坏消息，但我在离这儿不远的一些遗骸旁，找到了一把刻着他名字的剑。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {亮出剑。} 我也不想带来坏消息，但我在离这儿不远的一些遗骸旁，找到了一把刻着他名字的剑。

original_rows.source: {Abandon goal.} Never mind, I lost interest.
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"goal 在此位于受保护指令标记 {Abandon goal.} 内，按规则应原样保留，不能套用“目标”译名；标记外的“算了，我没兴趣了”已准确表达原意。","source":"goal"}]

original_rows.source: {Kill her.} Can't have any loose ends.
original_rows.translation: {Kill her.} 不能留下任何后患。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {杀了她。} 不能留下任何后患。

original_rows.source: {Challenge him yourself.} And yet you'll be no match for me!
original_rows.translation: {Challenge him yourself.} 可你根本不是我的对手！
original_rows.proposed_translation: {亲自挑战他。} 可你根本不是我的对手！

original_rows.source: {Drink} To a generous and giving host!
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"本句 generous 直接修饰主人，意为“慷慨大方”，并非交易中的“优惠”；现译准确，故不套用术语译名。","source":"generous"}]
[{"reason":"rope位于整句受保护占位标记{Throw rope.}中，按保护规则必须保留原文，不能译为“绳索”。","source":"rope"}]

original_rows.source: {Abandon goal.} Forget it, I lost interest.
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处“goal”属于游戏功能标记{Abandon goal.}，按保护规则整体保留原文，不应译为“目标”。","source":"goal"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {放弃目标。} 算了，我没兴趣了。

original_rows.source: {Chicken out.} This has already gone too far. I want no further part of it.
original_rows.translation: {Chicken out.} 这事已经闹得太过了。我不想再掺和下去。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {临阵退缩。} 这事已经闹得太过了。我不想再掺和下去。

original_rows.source: {Pick your nails with the point of the knife.} Grant docking permission to the [Shipname], and I will let you keep all your fingers.
original_rows.translation: {Pick your nails with the point of the knife.} 准许我的[Shipname]停靠，我就让你保住你的全部手指。
original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"此处“knife”是普通名词“刀”，指用刀尖剔指甲，并非专名，现译按普通词义处理正确。","source":"knife"}]
original_rows.proposed_translation: {用小刀尖剔着指甲。} 准许我的[Shipname]停靠，我就让你保住你的全部手指。

original_rows.source: {Chicken out.} This has already gone too far. I want no further part of it.
original_rows.translation: {Chicken out.} 这事已经闹得太过了。我不想再掺和下去。
original_rows.proposed_translation: {临阵退缩。} 这事已经闹得太过了。我不想再掺和下去。
{同意交易。} 这看起来挺公道。

original_rows.exceptions: [{"reason":"rope 只出现在原文受保护的完整选项“{Throw rope.}”内，必须保留整段原文，因此不能单独替换为“绳索”。","source":"rope"}]
